SEARCH
Package org.finos.fluxnova.bpm.engine.rest.filter

Class EngineRoutingFilter

java.lang.Object
org.finos.fluxnova.bpm.engine.rest.filter.EngineRoutingFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Filter
public class EngineRoutingFilter extends Object implements jakarta.servlet.Filter
A servlet filter that routes requests to a named process engine based on a configurable HTTP request header. When a request arrives without an engine name in the path and the header value maps to a non-default process engine, the request is forwarded to the engine-specific path (e.g. /engine/{name}/...).

The header name is configurable via the "engineHeaderName" filter init parameter. If not configured, it falls back to "x-fxn-engine", but consumers are expected to override this with a header name appropriate for their deployment (e.g. x-tenant-id).

Example web.xml configuration: 


 <filter>
   <filter-name>EngineRoutingFilter</filter-name>
   <filter-class>org.finos.fluxnova.bpm.engine.rest.filter.EngineRoutingFilter</filter-class>
   <init-param>
     <param-name>engineHeaderName</param-name>
     <param-value>x-tenant-id</param-value>  <!-- override with your own header name -->
   </init-param>
 </filter>
 <filter-mapping>
   <filter-name>EngineRoutingFilter</filter-name>
   <url-pattern>/*</url-pattern>
 </filter-mapping>

    • DEFAULT_ENGINE_HEADER_NAME

      public static final String DEFAULT_ENGINE_HEADER_NAME
      The initial value used for the engine routing header name if no "engineHeaderName" init-param is found. This is not intended to be a permanent value — consuming applications should override it via web.xml with a header name that matches their own conventions (e.g. x-tenant-id).

    • shouldRewritePath

      protected boolean shouldRewritePath(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest httpReq, ProcessEngine engineFromHeader)
      Returns true when the request should be rewritten to the named-engine path.

      Rewriting is skipped when:

      • no engine was resolved from the header,
      • the resolved engine is the default engine,
      • the request path already contains an engine name segment, or
      • the request targets the engine-listing endpoint itself.

    • doesRequestSupportEngineNameInPath

      protected boolean doesRequestSupportEngineNameInPath(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest httpReq)
      Returns true when the request URL does not already carry an engine name segment. Requests to the bare "/engine" listing path are excluded because they do not support an engine-name sub-path.

    • isEngineNameInPath

      protected boolean isEngineNameInPath(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest httpReq)
      Returns true when the request path already contains a named-engine segment, i.e. matches /engine/<name> or /engine/<name>/....

    • extractEngineNameFromPath

      protected String extractEngineNameFromPath(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest httpReq)
      Extracts the engine name from a request path that follows the pattern /engine/<name>/... or /engine/<name>, or returns null if the path does not match.

    • isDefaultEngine

      protected boolean isDefaultEngine(ProcessEngine engine)
      Returns true when engine is the JVM-default process engine or is named "default". Requests routed to the default engine do not need the /engine/<name> path prefix, so the header can simply be omitted.

    • buildEngineSpecificPath

      protected String buildEngineSpecificPath(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest httpReq, ProcessEngine engine)
      Builds the forwarding path for the given named engine, e.g. <servletPath>/engine/<engineName><pathInfo>.
